descriptions.areas: Define rooms and areas to organize your devices in Home Assistant.
descriptions.binary_sensor: Binary sensors react to press and release events. Use them for simple on/off inputs like door sensors or motion detectors.
descriptions.event: Event entities handle button actions: single click, double click, and long press. Ideal for wall switches and buttons.
descriptions.output: Configure relay outputs to control lights, switches, and other devices.
descriptions.output_group: Group multiple outputs together to control them as a single entity.
descriptions.cover: Configure covers like blinds, shutters, and garage doors with open/close relays.
descriptions.modbus_devices: Add Modbus devices like energy meters, temperature sensors, and other RS485 equipment.
descriptions.sensor: Configure 1-Wire temperature sensors (DS18B20) connected to your device.
descriptions.virtual_energy_sensor: Configure virtual energy and water sensors linked to outputs for Home Assistant Energy panel.
